tells.why: You looked at the full address before sending. Autocomplete picks the most recent Mark, not the right one.
The warning said the recipient was outside Harbor. That banner is there for exactly this.
You knew what was in the attachment: customer names, addresses, phones.
Sent to the wrong person? Report it right away. Security can act; deleting it from Sent can't.
